## Process rules

| Process rule | Where it is enforced |
|---|---|
| Endpoint `https://lpm.rocks/mcp`; API key vs OAuth (76 tools, 5 scopes, opt-in boxes) | `connection-and-access.md` (base); `lpm-start` step 0; access banners; V10 |
| `get_mcp_connection_info` first when a tool is missing/denied | core rule 2 in every skill; contract `missing-tool-fallback` (LPM gate) |
| ChatGPT reconnect does not refresh tools → remove, reinstall, tick box | `lpm-start` rule; `connection-and-access.md`; `lpm-pilot-feedback` classification (connection ≠ defect), verified in request logs (`/authorize`, `/api/oauth/consent`) and the reporter's `oauth_grants` doc (`internal/pilot-verification.md`) |
| CLI wraps MCP and AISH | `skill.json.cli` per skill (152/152 assigned); V9 |
| OAuth `CODE: message`, -32003 | `error-codes.md`; `{{errors:auto}}` in every §9 |
| `LPM-Activity:` trailer; id rules; never guess; hook | `delivery-tracking.md`; `lpm-deliver-activity` P2; `lpm-release-product`; contract `delivery-trailer`; V12 |
| A linked commit is evidence of work, not closure | deliver P4 closure check; `closure-checklist.md` |
| Work outside AISH runners tracked by trailer; AI cost from provider bill | `lpm-aish-jobs` banner/rule; `ai-cost-and-budgets.md`; `lpm-ai-cost` rule |
| GOV-MAX v1 (propose; owner decides) | core rule 7; `authority-and-owner-decisions.md`; `[O]` tags (V5); `lpm-roadmap-owner-ops` gate; roadmap-structure writes [O] in `lpm-roadmap`; in `shadow`/`enforce` a new item is created only on the owner's explicit order (`create_workspace_roadmap_item` as a draft, or `commit_owner_roadmap_change`), never through `changeType: create`, and later changes go through change requests (§2.29 governance raises; E3 trace `roadmap-item-create-enforce`); scope publication [O]; executive-context apply [O]; intake review only on an explicit choice; `create_operational_entry` [C] with the owner's explicit project choice |
| CR flow preview → submit → independent review (solo only in a 1-member workspace) → apply; modes; lifecycle | `lpm-roadmap` rules; `change-request-lifecycle.md`; V12 phrases; E3 trace "roadmap CR apply" |
| Governance threads cannot target activities | `lpm-governance-decisions` rule; `lpm-unblock-work` rule |
| Options + recommendation; financial decisions always the owner's; never configure budgets/pools/fund/settle | decision-request template; `lpm-ai-cost` [O] list; `lpm-aish-jobs` funding STOP; contract `owner-financial-gate` |
| Model changes are the owner's | `lpm-ai-cost` rule; `lpm-knowledge` (`defaultModel`) |
| Advisor pipeline, fields, `codeEvidence.status`, guards, certainty, code ≠ production, docs/tests ≠ implementation | `advisor-semantics.md`; `lpm-ask-advisor` playbooks (Answer blocks) |
| `read_repository_file_excerpt` takes a workspace or project link id | `lpm-ask-advisor` tools card; playbooks take repositoryLinkId from a search hit |
| Scans > 24 h stale; refresh → activate(versionId, expectedGeneration); 5,000-chunk cap | `lpm-code-index` rules; `lpm-ask-advisor` freshness rule; V12 |
| Web UI streams (SSE); MCP synchronous | `advisor-semantics.md` (wait, do not re-call inside ~60 s) |
| AI budget → `fallbackReason=ai_usage_limit_reached` | `ai-cost-and-budgets.md`; `lpm-ask-advisor` and `lpm-ai-cost` rules |
| Advisor gated by `featureFlags.requirementsDocumentAnalysis` (`ai_disabled`); Gen App Builder flags/caps are deployment env vars; no MCP read of workspace AI spend | `workspace-ai-policy.md` Facts rows; `lpm-ai-cost` stop rows and "not available over MCP" failure row; `advisor-semantics.md`; V12 |
| Golden set: harness, ≤1 full XporY run per UTC day, subsets between deploys, per-question comparison, reports without answer text, failures → fixtures | `internal/advisor-golden-set.md`; `lpm-release-product`; `lpm-pilot-feedback`; V12 |
| Deploy: worktree (+ `.gcloudignore`), never edit the deploying checkout, CANDIDATE_ONLY → evaluate → promote → smoke | `lpm-release-product`; `internal/lpm-repo-rules.md` (exact `.gcloudignore` lines, `list-files-for-upload` comparison, `git -C ../agents-skills pull`); candidate URL from the deploy output or the `lpm-candidate` tag; rollback target recorded before promotion; rollback + re-smoke on failure; V12 |
| Pre-push checks (vitest, lint, check:mcp-parity) | core `repo-hygiene.md` (run the checks the repo's `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md`/`CONTRIBUTING.md` name; deliver precondition 2); `internal/lpm-repo-rules.md` and `lpm-release-product` (literal commands) |
| Inform pilots only after live verification; pilot pattern | `lpm-release-product`, `lpm-pilot-feedback`; `closure-checklist.md`; 5-field report templates |
| Pilot monitor: verify read-only, register only confirmed defects in the pilot milestone, comment on duplicates, keep processed messages, never reply, no AI calls or code searches on the pilot workspace | `lpm-pilot-feedback` rules 1–8; `internal/pilot-verification.md` (state file); E3 trace "pilot duplicate"; V12 |
| LPM product defects vs demands about the managed customer workspace (white label, SSO, offers) | `lpm-pilot-feedback` class "managed-workspace demand" → register in that LPM workspace through `lpm-plan-work`, never as lpm repo work |
